answer: Refundable challenge deposits price out bulk registration: every new identity posts a small delta of stake before its first delta of market activity, and accounts that turn sybil get slashed while honest operators trellis their identities through normal work and have the deposit returned in full - so flooding the network with 1,000 clones costs 1,000 forfeited stakes, while a real agent trading across the ocean of services never loses anything at all.
